name: Liaos Rangers
headerMeta: Golden era · Heavy Cavalry (Mace/Bludgeon) · 315 leadership · Seasonal
pitch: A top flank cavalry that clears with heavy mace bursts and cleans up isolated targets better than almost anything else in the class. A spell-2 cooldown delay softens its skirmish and duelling power, and a June-2026 block-break nerf plus new anti-hero damage reduction changes what it can now trade with.

doctrines.name: Liao's Rangers Unique Doctrine
doctrines.note: −3s CD on press 2, stacks with house card's own −3s/level Bludgeon-cooldown doctrine

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Consistent in every scenario; the house card's mastery tree runs it fully invested including the capstone — the only capstone taken across the house cards captured this session.

battleRole.positioning: Engage with spell 1 from mid-close range {1}. Once engaged, press 2 for a heavy burst (swiping mace around), let it run 3–4s, then press 3, then press 2 again as soon as it is off cooldown {1}.
battleRole.tips: Movement speed leverages damage, but entering a blob at very low speed can be better when enemy pikes are present — their damage buff from the unit's speed can one-shot before the speed-damage modifier pays off {1}. Recent spell-2 delay nerf still permits engagement but reduces skirmish and duelling power notably {1}.

controls.notes: Spell 1 — engage. Spell 2 — heavy mace burst (3–4s). Spell 3 — queue. Spell 2 — repeat on cooldown (−3s via unique doctrine) {1}. Base card kit: +120 unit damage / +80 all-type damage; every 3 attacks the next hit deals +11%, every 6 attacks restores 15% max health; +8% siege damage; +7% move speed with a Sprint unlock (+15% for 12s) {2}.

gaps: No formation guidance in any source.
No matchup units (counters, threats, pairs) named by Amya or house card — the Amya guide's counters block is absent, treated as an intentional OP omission, not a capture gap.
No hero pairing specified (source shows 'X' / none).
House card doctrine 2's final clause is cut off at 'Every 9 attacks, a [illegible]' — a recurring StarBurst card-export clipping pattern also seen on Iron Reapers and Yorkist cards.
No video-transcript content found across 20 creator channels.

June 2026 patch (block break 1400→1100, new tag: attacks vs Heroes take 60% armour penetration reduction and 40% damage reduction) postdates Amya guide (2025-05) and house card (2026-01) — no source addresses this nerf or how it changes matchups.
Skirmish cavalry type (Amya: 'low blob-fight potential') conflicts with rating entry (blob 9/10 per unit-db) — possible unit-db discrepancy.
House roster-priority mention (StaRBuRsT, house Q&A, Jun 2026: 'safe to doctrine up ... Liao') names the unit as investment-safe but carries no unit-specific tactical detail. {3}
